name: Northwest Youth Corps Portland Youth Community Crews
what_you_do: A 5 week day program. Crews of 8 to 9 teens plant trees, pull invasive plants, build trails and put up fences around Portland. They get a daily lesson, then go home.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18. You live in a northwest community where the program runs. The page names Portland area sites.
pay_detail: Stipend of $480 a week plus up to $40 a week in bonuses (up to $520). Tuition fee $200, with need-based assistance available.
duration: 5 weeks, Monday to Friday (2026: June 15 to July 17 or July 21 to Aug 21)
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted; the 2027 application cycle is not posted. Dates may change.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Northwest Youth Corps site (Apply link on the program page). Ask info@nwyouthcorps.org about help with tuition and school credit.
notes: You may be able to earn high school credit. Your school decides, and requests are handled only after you finish. Oregon BOLI does not give work permits to minors ages 14 to 17. Employers need a certificate to hire minors.
